summary: archetype-index-sdk ships obfuscated import-time loader with hidden network/host references
details: The package main dist/index.js begins with bare side-effect imports of two ~250KB sibling modules (telemetry-info.mjs and runtime-matrix.mjs) that consist of a hex-named base64/XOR string array plus a decoder on a single long line, with no exports. These modules execute on any require/import of archetype-index-sdk. The decoder/caller references `cA.host`, `st.got`, `st.bt`, and `Date.now` outside the obfuscated string table, consistent with an endpoint and request/timing fields reconstructed from the decoded strings at module load. The files use cover-story names (`telemetry-info`, `runtime-matrix`, header comment `runtime compatibility snapshot`) inconsistent with a zero-dependency catalog library's declared purpose, and the obfuscator shape (string-array + XOR + base64 with hex identifiers) is the standard pattern used to hide destination hosts and payloads handed to network or dynamic-execution sinks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
